comment: Dr. Stohr is the best professor/ teacher I've ever had. Cares about her students so much and always available outside the classroom for feedback or help. Class is so engaging and helped prepare me to become a teacher.

Dr. Stohr is a great professor. Her assignments are set up as points instead of percentages, so you have obtain a certain amount of points to pass, and that can be determined by fewer projects with larger points or more projects with few points. You choose and manage your semester. I loved it and would take it again.

Dr. Stohr is great! While she packs A LOT into her class periods, she makes sure you get a full understanding of what you're going to teach and provides examples of best practices. Reading is minimal and projects are manageable if you manage your time well. She is very realistic with real world issues and constraints these issues may have on class.
When I grow up, I want to be prof. stohr-hunt
Very helpful outside of class - Moves VERY quickly in class and requires LOTS of work

Dr. Stohr makes class time fun, but it is a lot of busy work and a ton of handouts. If you are going to take 306, be sure to buy 3 or 4 one inch binders to hold all of the handouts. She's a really helpful teacher outside of class, but really rushes through material in class. Overall, class was a good experience.

She's nice, goes straight to the point, and makes an 8 am class fun. We have at least 2 projects each week, sometimes 3 or 4.  The reading is very minimal, but the projects will kill you.  Oh, and she always teaches it at 8.  She's a great prof tho, really helpful
